description: This file defines a NoteEditor component using LightningJS framework, providing UI and logic for editing and deleting notes.

classes.name: NoteEditor
classes.description: A LightningJS component for editing notes, including title and body, with delete functionality.

methods.name: _emitChange
methods.description: Emits a change event with updated note data.

methods.name: _appendChar
methods.description: Appends a character to the current note's title or body based on mode.

methods.name: _backspace
methods.description: Removes the last character from the current note's title or body.

methods.name: $confirmDelete
methods.description: Handles delete confirmation and triggers onDelete callback.
